questions.question: This man built an ark to save his family and two of every animal from a great flood.

This first man, formed from dust, lived with Eve in the Garden of Eden.

This man, a former persecutor of Christians, was blinded on the road to Damascus and became a major apostle.
This cousin of Jesus baptized him in the Jordan River.
This disciple famously doubted Jesus' resurrection until he touched his wounds.
This first book of the Bible tells the story of creation.

This mountain is where Moses received the Ten Commandments.
This river is where John the Baptist baptized Jesus.

finalJeopardy.answer: What is the Sabbath (the seventh day)?
